_doc: BASELINE of pre-existing LINKAGE BREAKS and UNENFORCED MONEY POINTERS. DEBT REGISTER, not approval. NEW breaks fail the build. Wire an edge and DELETE its entry.
_scope: SCHEMA REACHABILITY ONLY. It cannot prove rows are populated, that a poster runs, or that reverse drill-through exists in the UI. LAW 0: prod wins over migrations, and prod has diverged — a pass here is not a statement about prod's FK graph. Never cite this guard as proof the books are wired.
_corrected: 2026-07-21 review: (1) the unenforced-pointer detector was defined but NEVER CALLED while three real findings (settlement_lines.posting_account_id, fuel_transactions.vendor_id, accident_reports.driver_id) were removed in deference to it — it now runs and is baselined; (2) `if (have.size===0) continue` exempted zero-FK tables, the worst break, by construction — removed, which surfaced insurance.lawsuit driver+unit; (3) polymorphic gl/source satisfaction was a hardcoded table list — now derived from the linked_object_type / source_transaction_type literals that actually appear in backend source; (4) junction satisfaction accepted ANY table referencing both sides — now requires a genuine narrow link table; (5) dollar-quoted DO bodies were discarded, hiding maintenance.work_orders and safety.accident_reports entirely.

_pointer_doc: A money-critical uuid declared with NO FOREIGN KEY. It accepts any value and dangles when its target is removed: wired in a column list, not in the database. Fixing these is additive-migration work (ADD CONSTRAINT ... NOT VALID, then VALIDATE after an orphan sweep) and is FINANCIAL CLUSTER — owner-approved, never self-merged.
